about: Hand-written expectations for #74 (tests/test_issue74_mean_times.py). Invented incidents. Passages of the incidents whose order is known, in hours: Open>Assign 2, 1, 0 (T3 two records at one time); Assign>Assign 7 (a repeat); Assign>Close 6, 5, 12; Open>Close 0.5 (T4, over a record without label) and 240 (T7, the long tail). T5's order is not known; T6 has one record. Means rest on exactly the passages of the medians. Never read by product code.
